fine_lines.title: taller vs the tallest
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم المقارنة taller + than لمقارنة شيئين، ونستخدم التفضيل the tallest للأعلى في مجموعة كاملة (ثلاثة أو أكثر).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use taller than to compare two. Use the tallest for the top one in a group.

fine_lines.title: better vs the best
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good صفة شاذة: better = أفضل من، the best = الأفضل على الإطلاق. لا نقول gooder.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Good is irregular: better (than), the best. Never "gooder".

examples.sentence: Georgie's cake is better than Buli's.

fine_lines.title: worse vs the worst
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bad صفة شاذة: worse = أسوأ من، the worst = الأسوأ على الإطلاق. لا نقول badder.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Bad is irregular: worse (than), the worst. Never "badder".

fine_lines.title: than vs then
fine_lines.explanation_ar: than للمقارنة (أطول من)، أما then فتعني ثم / بعد ذلك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Than is for comparing; then means after that.

examples.sentence: We made cakes, then we ate them.

grammar.title: Comparatives: adjective + -er + than
grammar.explanation_ar: لمقارنة شيئين نضيف er إلى الصفة القصيرة ثم than: tall → taller than. الصفة المنتهية بـ y: happy → happier.
grammar.explanation_en: To compare two things, add -er + than. Adjectives ending in -y: happy → happier.
examples: I'm taller than Georgie, but shorter than Buli.
I'm weaker than Buli, but stronger than Tim.
I was faster than Tim, but slower than Georgie.

grammar.title: Superlatives: the + adjective + -est
grammar.explanation_ar: للأعلى في مجموعة نستخدم the + الصفة + est: the tallest, the strongest, the happiest.
grammar.explanation_en: For the top one in a group: the + adjective + -est.
examples: You are the happiest person here.

grammar.title: Irregular: good / bad
grammar.explanation_ar: good → better → the best، وbad → worse → the worst.
grammar.explanation_en: Good → better → the best. Bad → worse → the worst.
examples: Tim's cake is better than Buli's cake.
